issues.description: The Bitmap24 class visibility differs between the template and the solution. In the template header, Bitmap24's data members and its constructors/destructor and methods are declared under a private section (making construction and usage from other translation units impossible). In the solution header the same members and methods are public. This mismatch will prevent students from compiling or using Bitmap24 as intended (e.g. main.cpp instantiates Bitmap24 and calls resize_buffer), causing confusion and build failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Bitmap24 constructors, destructor, and public API methods (resize_buffer, save, set) public in the template header to match the solution. For example, add a 'public:' label before the constructor declarations and API method declarations, and keep internal data members private if desired. Ensure the header's visibility matches the intended usage in main.cpp.
